name: Sidebar
description: Vertical navigation along the side of an app or dashboard, with icons, badges, multi-level groups, a logo and a call to action. Below a breakpoint it opens as a drawer.
import: import { Sidebar, SidebarCollapse, SidebarCTA, SidebarItem, SidebarItemGroup, SidebarItems, SidebarLogo, SidebarProvider, SidebarToggle, useSidebar } from "@stefan-florescu/ui";
useWhen: The main navigation of an app, dashboard or admin panel with many sections
Navigation with nested groups, counts or status tags next to the items
avoidWhen: A marketing site with a few top-level links: use a navbar
A temporary panel of actions or a form: use Drawer
Tabs between views of the same content: use tabs
